rows.en: But get this!! With soft, namby-pamby power like yours, that's as far as you'll ever go!!
It's the power of evil that rules this world! Pure evil!! THIS is the power that will lead the world!!
Indeed... the power that leads the world to a good end... Now bow down before that power!!
Now then... I'll have you be the flowers that adorn an even better ending!!
Fuhahahahahahahaha...!! I can feel the Minus Energy seeping into every inch of me!!
Power is welling up inside me... This is marvelous!!
...These guys are powering up with the Minus Energy!?
Indeed... The Minus Energy has been amplified by orders of magnitude!!
And it's all thanks to you!!!
The hell's that supposed to mean!?
All the Minus Energy gathered from every Cube...
King Pandon, Zetton and Tyrant guarded the stone pillars and were the keys to releasing the energy...
When you lot defeated them, a massive amount of Minus Energy was released.
That energy became a cloud... and just now, it came pouring down on us!!
You've practically powered us up with your own hands.
In this world brimming with fear, despair and hatred, in other words, in "Regis",
we have at last taken in every evil power there is!!

notes.note: Belial answers the heroes' defiance from story_162 (#0.216 admits they withstood his attack). 'amacchoroi' = soft/naive; kept the sneer.
'hana wo soeru' = adorn/grace: the heroes' defeat is to decorate Dinosaur Greeed's 'better ending' (his recurring end/finish theme).
#0.222 Belial and #0.223 Dinosaur Greeed power-up roars as Minus Energy clouds pour onto them (script plays lightning/aura SFX here).
Script 0731 always plays only #0.224 here (MessWinSet +223, no leader offset) under the leader's name; #0.225-238 are unused duplicates. Identical Japanese, identical English.

Scream block #0.242-256 is MessWinSet 241+k. In 0731 the leader check runs Pt_Chara_Check 15,5,14,4,13,3,12,2,11,1,6,7,8,9,10 and sets k = chain position, so k order = Zero, OOO, Mebius, W, Taro, Den-O, Seven, RX, Ultraman, Rider 1, Nu, Zeta, God, Wing Zero, 00. Wording confirms: all four non-Zero Ultras get the growl variant, Den-O (#0.247) the 'owaa' one, God (#0.254) 'guhaa'.
Ankh: 'koitsura, mainasu enerugii de!?' - verb restored ('are powering up'), referring to Belial and Dinosaur Greeed absorbing the cloud.

Script plays #0.260 if the leader is chara 3 (Den-O, Momotaros voice: rough 'shinjirarenee') and #0.258 otherwise; the rest of #0.258-272 are unused. Same for #0.275/#0.277 ('doiu kotta' = Momotaros).

Belial's sentence continues in #0.301 (story_164: 'had been compressed and stored inside those stone pillars.'), which the script plays right after this row; ends with '...' so the continuation reads, no comma between subject and verb.
'sekichuu no mamori' = guardians of the stone pillars; 'enerugii kaihou no kagi' = keys to releasing the energy.
Subject 'that energy' restored (the released Minus Energy became the cloud).
Sentence spans #0.297/#0.298 split at the source's comma. 'onnen' = grudges/hatred. Regis in quotes as in the source: here Belial names the world itself 'Regis'.

report: 80/80 examined. Speakers verified against 0731.bla; slice labels match except the '00' labels on leader blocks (script's dynamic leader name). Leader blocks: #0.224 and #0.258/#0.260, #0.275/#0.277 are the only rows the script plays; scream block #0.242-256 follows Pt_Chara_Check chain 15,5,14,4,13,3,12,2,11,1,6,7,8,9,10. story_164's note on #0.302 assumes id order 1-15 for its leader block; per the bytecode k = chain position (Zero, OOO, Mebius, W, Taro, Den-O, ...), harmless there since the variants are identical. No new names.
